summary: A disciplined, well-planned session: thorough spec/test/data analysis up front (including a fetch-cost benchmark and the Deoxys variety pitfall), one architecture never revisited, and root-cause debugging of both hard test failures — the sort bug solved by Playwright trace forensics. Deductions are for self-inflicted friction: failed multi-block edits, careless background-process cleanup that invalidated a screenshot run, and a visual fix that was never re-screenshot. Final state was confirmed with a full 54/54 test pass after the last edit, plus visual comparison against the reference designs.
